patterns.qr_generation: Uses lib/qrcode/generator.ts with functions: generateQRCodeSVG, generateQRCodePNG, generateQRCodePDF. Returns QRCodeGenerationResult with success/data/error.
patterns.individual_download: Tables page has handleDownloadQR function (lines 412-469) that generates QR and triggers browser download using createElement('a')
patterns.bulk_pattern: lib/guards/limits.ts has validateBulkAdd function that checks if bulk operations are allowed against plan limits
patterns.client_component: Tables page is a 'use client' component with React hooks for state management
patterns.error_handling: Uses try/catch with setError state to display errors in UI

existing_implementations.description: QR code generation already exists for individual tables. The tables page (app/(dashboard)/tables/page.tsx) has handleDownloadQR function that downloads single table QR codes in SVG, PNG, or PDF format. The QR generator module (lib/qrcode/generator.ts) provides all necessary QR generation functions.

key_functions.generateQRCodePDF: Generates A5 PDF with QR code
key_functions.handleDownloadQR: Downloads individual table QR using browser download

feature_requirements.primary_goal: Add ability to download all table QR codes at once as either ZIP or combined PDF
download_formats: ZIP file containing individual PNG QR codes for each table
Combined PDF containing all table QR codes in one document
feature_requirements.ui_location: Tables page (app/(dashboard)/tables/page.tsx) - add bulk download button near 'New Table' button
feature_requirements.file_naming: Use organization slug and timestamp for file names
dependencies_to_add: jszip - for creating ZIP files in browser
